role: checkpoint 4 synthetic calculation and Monte Carlo validation; not biological replicates or held-out community data
rng: NumPy Generator PCG64; independent SeedSequence([scenario_seed, replicate_index]) per study; methods share each study

scenarios.name: dense_null
scenarios.generator: independent bounded latent log coordinates Uniform(-1,1); inverse additive-pseudocount closure; all CLR distribution nulls true

scenarios.name: unbalanced_null
scenarios.generator: same exchangeable dense-null population, unequal group sizes

scenarios.name: sparse_null
scenarios.generator: independent log weights Uniform(-2,2), 0.65 independent dropout except first two features; multinomial depth 1000 drawn from normalized surviving weights; identical population in both groups

scenarios.name: balanced_clr_effect
scenarios.generator: independent bounded log coordinates Uniform(-1,1); comparison shifts +1 and -1 in features f00/f01, zero-sum; inverse additive-pseudocount closure makes production CLR truth exact

inverse_closure: Let w=softmax(z); observed proportions=(1+D*pseudocount)*w-pseudocount. Bounded z guarantees positivity; clr(observed+pseudocount)=z-mean(z). No production CLR code is used by the generator.
null_metrics: Under the global null FDR=Pr(any FDR discoveries). Report events/500 and two-sided 95% Wilson interval; no per-feature independence assumption.
effect_metrics: Per-study FDP=false discoveries/max(all discoveries,1), recall=detected changed features/2; report mean, Monte Carlo SE, and one-sided 95% Hoeffding bounds over independent studies. Direction success requires both known target signs correct, with 95% Wilson interval.

acceptance_limits.interpretation: Proposed project screening criteria with declared Monte Carlo margins; these do not prove nominal 5% FDR control for all datasets. Report nominal alpha and empirical estimates even if a screening criterion passes.

resource_plan: No external reads/databases; 2000 small synthetic studies evaluated with both methods; arrays at most 48x24, target under 10 minutes and under 1 GB RAM on the laptop. Retain actual resources without claiming controlled performance.
sensitivity_checks: Predeclared descriptive (no pass/fail accuracy claim): rerun the balanced CLR-effect inputs under pseudocount 1e-4 and min_prevalence 0.5; run sparse-null inputs under pseudocount 1e-4 for first 50 replicates. Do not relabel changed CLR hypotheses as fixed effect truth.
independent_calculation_checks: Enumerate small-sample U permutations including ties; check a documented SciPy reference example, independent step-up BH/BY values, CLR log-ratios, prevalence reference changes, group reversal and sample/feature reorder invariance.
limits: No pairing, covariate/batch adjustment, causal effects, biological sensitivity/specificity or absolute abundance truth.
Small samples and ties use the existing SciPy auto exact/asymptotic policy; report limitations.
Public 2.0.0b2 artifacts remain unchanged; this branch is an unreleased audit candidate.
